participation.context: Said Norwich, and kept the room.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Had them say it, and named the loaf without measuring it.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Said she had not opened the door.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Said Norwich, and that the night had been quiet.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

story.body: You repeated the sentence at breakfast and did not go out. Nobody had come to test it.
